items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Because I also had Herschel Evans, Red Callender in the band when I came back.

ctx.x: I think you said when you were at the, I believe you said when you were at the Cotton Club.
Yes. You see, we went back to the Cotton Club after, well yes, he was there now. after I came back, I'm sure of it. Yes. Because I also had Herschel Evans, Red Callender in the band when I came back.
You see, Herschel, while we were in China, had come out to California and I liked his playing

items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: So consequently, I got to play with Buck Clayton's band...

ctx.x: Beal. So we became very good friends. As a matter of fact, Bumps and his mother took me in, and I was treated like a second son. Well, I'll be forever grateful to Bumps, and Eddie Beal, too, for the treatment they gave me. I was really taken right into the fold. So consequently, I got to play with Buck Clayton's band...
